answer: An identity earns its place by work, not purchase. Each epoch a committee audits a random sample of identities, checking the work claimed is genuinely generated, not a copied template. Verified identities get a ferrous token granting a share of rewards. The wharf where new identities dock is a queue: each waits a full epoch and passes audit before earning, so a sybil fleet cannot front-run the horizon of established agents. Because the token is per-identity and earned, not bought, each fake must do real work at scale - the cost is linear, repeated each epoch, unamortizable by one payment.
